purpose: 동일 거래의 금액만 일괄 축소해 소비 규모·한도 소진 여부에 따른 선택 방식 차이를 비교한다.
scaling: Every original amount * percentage / 100; exact integer required; no rounding, filtering, reordering or resampling.

random.mapping: Same card count and seed have identical selected indexes across all scales; nextInt(2) and nextInt(3) differ.

initialState: Each card: previous performance 400000; current performance and limit usage zero; available credit 10000000; ACTIVE/NORMAL; first card remains default. Success assumed.
facts: Reuse EXP-001 facts for two cards, approved EXP-002 additional facts for three cards. No new facts or product policies.
publication: Publish all five scales and both card counts, including ties and losses. 100% values are archived references, not new runs. Any later condition change requires a different experiment.
interpretation: Low-spend, fixed-prior-performance synthetic sensitivity analysis; no population inference or next-month performance claim. Unconstrained immediate maximum is expected to dominate fixed choices; this alone is not proof of long-horizon optimization.
